title: 5.2.15 Challenges: Optional Stretch
description: Add a second, harder-to-reach goal and track a two-goal completion count. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Create a canvas
steps.instructions: Inside setup(), create a canvas of any size.
hints: Open the moSHion docs drawer on the right and find the Canvas section.

steps.title: Build a scene with two goals
steps.instructions: Build a player/ground scene, then add two separate goal sprites instead of one.
hints: Check the Sprite section of the moSHion docs drawer for constructor arguments.

steps.title: Track how many goals are collected
steps.instructions: Use a counter (or check how many goal variables remain) to know when both goals are gone.
hints: content.md describes two acceptable ways to track this.

steps.title: Print the finish message once
steps.instructions: Print "All goals collected!" only after both goals are gone, and only once.
hints: Re-read 5.2.11 for the single-fire guard pattern.

requirements.title: Create a canvas
requirements.description: A canvas is created when the sketch starts.

requirements.title: Build a scene with two goals
requirements.description: At least three sprites are created (the player and two goals, at minimum).

requirements.title: Track collection progress
requirements.description: Your code tracks how many goals have been collected, using any technique: an incrementing counter or a check against a collection's length.

requirements.title: Print the finish message
requirements.description: "All goals collected!" is printed once both goals are gone.
